title: Canonical Tate comparisons at common finite coefficient stages
statement: For a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and schemes where $\ell$ is invertible, retain the canonical common-stage Tate line pullback, evaluation at every larger coefficient field through the scalar comparison, and uniquely normalized tensor-power comparison at every common finite stage. Retain the commuting scheme-square compositor. The line objects, least finite stage and all larger-stage comparison formulas are exactly those of [def-pur-canonical-tate-scalar-comparisons] and [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], with no change to their statements or data.

source.place: Canonical roots-of-unity Tate factors and their tensor, coefficient and pullback comparisons in the source-of-purity composite.

proof.text: Use the published object formula for common-stage pullback and include the already specified rational pullback comparison at the chosen finite base. At a larger field compose the stage transition with the scalar-normalized rational line map. Retain the original commonProduct_existsUnique statement as its unchanged named hole, with its complete source and proof description. Its chosen product and the commuting-square compositor are the original definitions. These declarations are relocated verbatim after local opacity and other definition optimizations still left the combined common-stage/reduction file at 63 seconds in delivery preflight.
